Powered by CesiumJS, MapLibre GL JS, OpenFreeMap, Esri imagery, OpenStreetMap, Photon and Open-Meteo geocoding. Imagery dates and resolution vary. This explorer uses an ellipsoid globe; photorealistic buildings, terrain elevation and Street View are not included.

Share this map view

This link includes the visible map centre, zoom and layer. Check the location before sharing.

Privacy & map data

Search terms are sent to Photon, with Open-Meteo as a fallback. Map providers receive requests for areas you view. Current location is requested only when you press the location button.

Share links contain map coordinates. Terra has no accounts, analytics or server-side location history. Map providers have their own data policies.

Road detail uses vector map data from OpenFreeMap and OpenStreetMap. Buildings, roads and names appear where contributors have mapped them. Satellite photography has different resolution limits by area.
